caption: The drawing depicts a powder flask rendered in a muted olive-green and brown color palette. The flask has a teardrop shape with a rounded bottom and tapers upward to a metallic cap and spout assembly, which is brass-colored. There is a small lever on the side near the top for dispensing the contents. On the front surface of the flask, an embossed design shows a standing man dressed in historical hunting attire, holding a bugle to his mouth with one hand and a staff in the other, with a dog standing by his side near his feet. The primary illustration is centered and labeled “actual size.” The drawing also includes two technical sketches: one in the top left corner, displaying the flask’s cap viewed from above with the words “actual size,” and one in the top right corner, showing a vertical outline of the flask with an indicated scale of “½ = 1”.” The entire drawing is signed “A. Walbeck” in the lower right corner.
title: Powder Horn
